name: mz1_window
variable: m_Z1 (the OS SF pair closest to m_Z, with FSR)
relaxed_to: 40 < m_Z1 < 120 GeV relaxed to 30 < m_Z1 < 130 GeV (event-record floor)

name: mz2_window
variable: m_Z2 (the other OS SF pair, with FSR)
threshold: 10 < m_Z2 < 120 GeV (signal region; smart cut with the same threshold)
relaxed_to: m_Z2 > 10 GeV (and the smart cut's threshold), m_Z2 < 120 GeV relaxed to 3-130 GeV (event-record floor; effectively 4 GeV through the kept m_ll(OS) > 4 GeV)

name: iso_rel_fsr
variable: relative PF isolation dR 0.3, FSR photons subtracted

name: min_pt_lep
relaxed_to: lepton pT > 5 (mu) / 7 (e) GeV relaxed to 3 / 5 GeV (event-record floor)

name: lead_sublead_20_10
relaxed_to: leading / subleading lepton pT > 20 / 10 GeV relaxed to 15 / 7 GeV (event-record floor)

name: os_pair_mass
relaxed_to: m_ll(OS) > 4 GeV relaxed to 2 GeV (event-record floor)

name: id_muon
threshold: PF muon (tracker high-pT ID above 200 GeV)
relaxed_to: muon identification (PF, or tracker high-pT) removed

name: dxy_lep
note: the event records carry this requirement as their loose-object floor: not relaxable without re-running the reconstruction

name: dz_lep
note: the event records carry this requirement as their loose-object floor: not relaxable without re-running the reconstruction

name: eta_lep
note: the event records carry this requirement as their loose-object floor: not relaxable without re-running the reconstruction

name: dr_lep
note: the event records carry this requirement as their loose-object floor: not relaxable without re-running the reconstruction

name: m4l_min
note: no effect inside the 118-130 GeV counting window

name: trigger_or
variable: the analysis trigger OR (single, double, triple lepton)
note: online requirement of every event; not relaxable

name: ghost_cross_cleaning
variable: muon ghosts (dR < 0.02, tracker duplicates within 0.05) and electrons within dR 0.05 of a muon
note: removing it would count one lepton twice
